about_the_game:
Ready to meet your new AI assistant? This app lets you chat with your chosen 2D model, and it's packed with cool features:

  • Smart Memory: Your AI remembers everything you've talked about, making conversations feel natural and continuous.

  • Powerful Tools: Your assistant can:

    • Read your screen

    • Do web searches

    • Generate photos

    • Open websites

    • Execute scripts

    • Copy content to your clipboard 

Privacy First: You're in full stealth mode – your privacy is completely protected.

  • Limited Mode: The app is fully free in Limited Mode, so you can try out all the features.

  • Unlimited Use: If you love it, just grab a free Gemini API key and use it as much as you want!

  • Custom Live2D Models: Want to chat with someone new? Easily add and interact with your own Live2D models instantly.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 730 / Radeon VEGA 8
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 730 / Radeon VEGA 8
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
